name: Read
description: Read a text file, or several files or line ranges with `paths`, as `anchor│content` rows; an anchor is 4 case-sensitive letters. Edit by anchor, never by content or line number. One file pages at 400 lines unless `limit` says otherwise; continue with `offset` (line number or anchor) from the hint. A stale anchor is refused: read again. A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP `file_path` comes back as the image itself, for checking screenshots. Other binary, UTF-16/32 and >64MB files are rejected.

file_path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

paths.description: Several files, each under a `== path` header: a path reads the whole file, {file_path, offset, limit} one range. Use instead of `cat` or a chain of `sed -n`.

offset.description: Line number (1-indexed) or a served anchor to start reading from

name: Bash
description: Run a bash command in the cwd, stderr merged into stdout, no stdin. Output keeps the last 2000 lines or 24KB (50KB with rtk off); a truncated run names its full log. With `run_in_background: true` it returns a task id at once and its final output arrives as a message when it exits; max 8 at once, killed when the agent exits.

timeout.description: Milliseconds; omit for none. Ignored in the background.

run_in_background.description: For servers, watchers and jobs longer than a minute

name: Write
description: Create or overwrite a file; creates parent directories.

file_path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

name: ReplaceLines
description: Replace the lines from anchor `remove_from` to anchor `remove_to` (the same anchor for one line) with `text`. Emptying a file returns its empty-line anchor for a follow-up ReplaceLines. To change part of a line, use Edit.

text.description: Exact new text; "" deletes. A trailing newline ends the last line, it adds no blank line.

name: Edit
description: Replace `old_string`, which must occur once, inside the lines from anchor `replace_from` to anchor `replace_to` (the same anchor for one line), or anywhere in the file at `file_path` when no anchors are given; no read needed. With `file_path`, `edits` changes several fragments in one call. The rest stays byte-for-byte. Send only the smallest changing fragment; for a whole-line rewrite use ReplaceLines.

file_path.description: File to search whole, in place of the anchors.

old_string.description: Exact text to find, copied from the served rows; only the part that changes. Line breaks are LF.

edits.description: Several fragments of the file at `file_path`, in place of old_string/new_string; applied in order, all or none.

name: InsertLines
description: Insert `text` after or before the line at `anchor`.

anchor.description: Anchor of the line to insert next to.

text.description: Exact text, without the anchor line; "" inserts one blank line. A trailing newline ends the last line, it adds no blank line.

name: ContextTreeQuery
description: Get back the original outputs of tool calls a pruner summary replaced, by the short refs it lists (e.g. ["t12", "t3"]).

toolCallIds.description: Short refs or raw tool call ids.

name: Todo
description: Task list for multi-step work. Status: pending, in_progress, completed; delete leaves a tombstone.

activeForm.description: Spinner label while in_progress, e.g. 'writing tests'

name: Goal
description: A goal the agent keeps working toward across turns. create only on explicit user request; get reads objective, status, tokens used and budget; complete marks it done once its done criteria are met, with the evidence that shows it.

objective.description: create: full objective; preserve ordered steps and done criteria.

token_budget.description: create: whole-token budget, only if supplied by the user.

evidence.description: complete: commands and results that prove the done criteria are met.

name: Agent
description: Spawn child agents as separate processes with their own context and no Agent, background, web or AskUserQuestion tools; an `explore: true` child only gets Read and Grep. Pass {description, prompt} for one child or {tasks: [...]} for several in parallel. Returns each child's final answer; with run_in_background: true, task ids now and answers later as messages.

prompt.description: Self-contained task; the child does not see this conversation

explore.description: Context gathering: only Read and Grep, cheaper

name: TaskWait
description: Wait for background Agent tasks (default: all running) and return their answers, which then do not arrive again as messages.

name: TaskOutput
description: A background Bash task's status and output tail, without blocking; without `task_id`, lists every task with pid, elapsed time, exit status and output sizes.

name: TaskStop
description: Stop background Bash tasks: SIGTERM to the process group, SIGKILL after 2s. Returns each final state.

name: AskUserQuestion
description: Ask the user structured questions for preferences, unclear instructions or decisions. A "Type something." row for a custom answer is added to every question; never write "Other", "Next" or "Type something." labels yourself. Put a recommended option first with "(Recommended)" at the end of its label. Use `preview` (markdown in a monospace box, single-select only) only to compare concrete artifacts such as mockups or code.

question.description: Clear, specific question ending with a question mark

preview.description: Shown when the option is focused

options.description: Distinct choices, mutually exclusive unless multiSelect

name: Grep
description: Search file contents with ripgrep: smart-case, respects .gitignore, at most 100 matches per file by default. Rows are `path:anchor│line` (match) and `path-anchor│line` (context); the anchors work in the edit tools without a Read. Output is capped at 2000 lines or 50KB.

output_mode.description: content (default): matching rows; files_with_matches: only paths; count: `path:matches` per file.

name: WebSearch
description: Search the web and return bounded, source-linked results or provider answers. Full results are stored for retrieval with GetSearchContent using the returned responseId.

queries.description: Up to 8, searched concurrently; vary the angles.

category.description: Exa only, e.g. news, research paper.

provider.description: Omit for the configured one; all or a list searches several.

name: WebFetch
description: Fetch web pages or GitHub repositories; full content is kept for GetSearchContent by the returned responseId.

mode.description: readable (default) extracts markdown; raw returns the body via direct HTTP.

name: GetSearchContent
description: Page through stored content of a WebSearch or WebFetch call, or find passages with findText.
